cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: The model applies the WHO Integrated Management of Childhood Illness (IMCI) protocol to classify illness in children 2 months to 5 years old and recommend the correct action. Pairing on-device language understanding with a published clinical standard is what makes it useful: it lets a community health worker in a low-connectivity clinic apply the chart booklet's logic from a free-text description of a child, offline, on a budget laptop.

test_prompts.prompt: A 9-month-old boy has had a cough for three days. You count 58 breaths per minute. There is no chest indrawing and no stridor when he is calm. Using the IMCI chart, how should this child be classified, and what should the health worker do?

A 2-year-old is brought to the clinic after having convulsions at home this morning. She is now lethargic and difficult to wake. How should this child be classified under IMCI, and what is the immediate action?
